text.en: 1. This Order is the International Organisations (Immunities and Privileges) (ReCAAP Information Sharing Centre) Order 2007.

3.—(1) The ISC is an organisation of which the Government and the governments of foreign sovereign Powers are members.
(2) The ISC has the legal capacities of a body corporate.

heading.en: Immunities and privileges of executive director of ISC
Immunities and privileges of professional staff of ISC
Immunities of members of governing council of ISC

text.en: 7. A member of the governing council of the ISC has the like immunity from suit and legal process as is accorded to an envoy of a foreign sovereign Power accredited to the Republic of Singapore in respect of acts (including words spoken or written) performed by the member in his or her official capacity or in the discharge of his or her duties.

heading.en: Non‑application to citizens and permanent residents of Singapore

text.en: 8. Despite anything in this Order, no immunity or privilege under paragraph 5, 6 or 7 may be enjoyed by any person who is a citizen or permanent resident of Singapore.
